sentences.en: MARTHA: Hi Alex.
sentences.zh: MARTHA: 嗨，Alex。

sentences.en: It's Martha Clines here.
sentences.zh: 我是玛莎·克莱恩。

sentences.en: James White gave me your number.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·怀特给了我你的电话号码。

sentences.en: I hope you don't mind me calling you.
sentences.zh: 希望你不要介意我给你打电话。

sentences.en: ALEX: Of course not.
sentences.zh: ALEX: 当然不介意。

sentences.en: How are you, Martha?
sentences.zh: 你最近怎么样，玛莎？

sentences.en: MARTHA: Good thanks.
sentences.zh: MARTHA: 很好，谢谢。

sentences.en: I'm ringing because I need a bit of advice. a
sentences.zh: 我打电话是因为需要一些建议。

sentences.en: ALEX: Oh yeah.
sentences.zh: ALEX: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: What about?
sentences.zh: 关于什么？

sentences.en: MARTHA: The training you did at JPNW a few years ago.
sentences.zh: MARTHA: 就是你几年前在JPNW公司接受的培训。

sentences.en: I'm applying for the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我正在申请同样的培训项目。

sentences.en: ALEX: Oh right.
sentences.zh: ALEX: 哦，明白了。

sentences.en: Yes, did mine in 2014.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是在2014年完成的。

sentences.en: Best thing I ever did.
sentences.zh: 这是我做过的最棒的一件事。

sentences.en: I'm still working there.
sentences.zh: 我现在仍在那儿工作。

sentences.en: Example
sentences.zh: 示例

sentences.en: MARTHA: Really?
sentences.zh: MARTHA: 真的吗？

sentences.en: What are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你现在在做什么工作？

sentences.en: ALEX: Well, now I work in the customer services department but I did my initial training in Finance.
sentences.zh: ALEX: 嗯，现在我在客户服务部工作，但最初接受的是财务方面的培训。

sentences.en: I stayed there for the first two years and then moved to where l am now.
sentences.zh: 我在财务部待了头两年，之后才调到目前这个部门。

sentences.en: MARTHA: That's the same department I'm applying for.
sentences.zh: MARTHA: 这正是我申请的部门。

sentences.en: Did you enjoy it?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢那份工作吗？

sentences.en: ALEX: I was pretty nervous to begin with.
sentences.zh: ALEX: 起初我相当紧张。

sentences.en: I didn't do well in my exams at school and was really worried because I failed Maths.
sentences.zh: 我在学校考试成绩不太好，而且特别担心，因为数学考砸了。

sentences.en: But it didn't actually matter because l did lots of courses on the job.
sentences.zh: 但实际上这并不重要，因为我入职后参加了大量在职课程。

sentences.en: MARTHA: Did you get diploma at the end of your trainee period?
sentences.zh: MARTHA: 你在实习期结束时拿到了文凭吗？

sentences.en: I'm hoping to do the one in business skills.
sentences.zh: 我希望拿到商业技能方向的文凭。

sentences.en: ALEX: Yes.
sentences.zh: ALEX: 是的。

sentences.en: That sounds good.
sentences.zh: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: I took the one on IT skills but I wish I'd done that.
sentences.zh: 我选的是信息技术技能文凭，但我真希望自己当初选的是商业技能文凭。

sentences.en: one instead.
sentences.zh: 而是选那个。

sentences.en: MARTHA: OK, that's good to know.
sentences.zh: MARTHA: 好的，这信息很有用。

sentences.en: What about the other trainees?
sentences.zh: 其他实习生呢？

sentences.en: How did you get on with them?
sentences.zh: 你和他们相处得如何？

sentences.en: ALEX: There were about 20 of us who started at the same time and we were all around the same age - was 18 and there was only one person younger than me, who was 17.
sentences.zh: ALEX: 一起开始培训的大约有20人，年龄都差不多——我当时18岁，只有一个人比我小，是17岁。

sentences.en: The rest were between 18 and 20. made some good friends.
sentences.zh: 其余的人年龄都在18到20岁之间。我交到了一些好朋友。

sentences.en: MARTHA: I've heard lots of good things about the training at JPNW.
sentences.zh: MARTHA: 我听说了很多关于JPNW公司培训的好评。

sentences.en: It seems like there are a lot of opportunities there.
sentences.zh: 看起来那里有很多发展机会。

sentences.en: ALEX: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: ALEX: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: Because of its size you can work in loads of different areas within the organisation.
sentences.zh: 由于其规模庞大，你可以在组织内部的众多不同领域工作。

sentences.en: MARTHA: What about pay?
sentences.zh: MARTHA: 薪资方面呢？

sentences.en: I know you get a lower minimum wage than regular employees.
sentences.zh: 我知道你的最低工资比正式员工要低。

sentences.en: ALEX: That's right which isn't great.
sentences.zh: ALEX: 没错，这确实不太理想。

sentences.en: But you get the same number of days' holiday as everyone else.
sentences.zh: 但你的带薪假期天数与其他人完全相同。

sentences.en: And the pay goes up massively if they offer you a job at the end of the training period.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果培训期结束后公司向你提供正式职位，薪资将大幅上涨。

sentences.en: MARTHA: Yeah, but I'm not doing it for the money - it's the experience I think will be really useful.
sentences.zh: MARTHA: 是啊，但我参加这个项目并不是为了钱——我觉得积累经验才真正有用。

sentences.en: Everyone says by the end of the year you gain so much confidence.
sentences.zh: 大家都说，到年底时你会获得极大的自信心。

sentences.en: ALEX: You're right.
sentences.zh: ALEX: 你说得对。

sentences.en: That's the most useful part about it.
sentences.zh: 这是其中最有价值的部分。

sentences.en: There's a lot of variety too.
sentences.zh: 此外，工作内容也十分丰富多样。

sentences.en: You're given lots of different things to do.
sentences.zh: 你会被安排做许多不同类型的任务。

sentences.en: I enjoyed it all - I didn't even mind the studying.
sentences.zh: 我全程都很享受——甚至不介意学习部分。

sentences.en: MARTHA: Do you have to spend any time in college?
sentences.zh: MARTHA: 你需要去学院上课吗？

sentences.en: ALEX: Yes, one day each month.
sentences.zh: ALEX: 需要，每月一天。

sentences.en: So you get lots of support from both your tutor and your manager.
sentences.zh: 因此，你既能从导师那里，也能从主管那里获得大量支持。

sentences.en: MARTHA: That's good.
sentences.zh: MARTHA: 这很好。

sentences.en: And the company is easy tO get to, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 而且这家公司交通很方便，对吧？

sentences.en: ALEX: Yes, it's very close to the train station so the location's a real advantage.
sentences.zh: ALEX: 对，它离火车站非常近，所以地理位置确实是一大优势。

sentences.en: nor or see a do pool-r•ee.............n.
sentences.zh: nor or see a do pool-r•ee.............n。

sentences.en: ALEX: Have you got date for your interview yet?
sentences.zh: ALEX: 你的面试日期确定了吗？

sentences.en: MARTHA: Yes, it's on the 23rd of this month.
sentences.zh: MARTHA: 确定了，是本月23号。

sentences.en: ALEX: So long as you're well prepared there's nothing to worry about.
sentences.zh: ALEX: 只要准备充分，就没什么好担心的。

sentences.en: Everyone's very friendly.
sentences.zh: 大家人都很友善。

sentences.en: Audioscripts
sentences.zh: 听力原文

sentences.en: MARTHA: am not sure what I should wear.
sentences.zh: MARTHA: 我不太确定该穿什么。

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得呢？

sentences.en: ALEX: Nothing too casual - like jeans, for example.
sentences.zh: ALEX: 别穿太随意的——比如牛仔裤之类的。

sentences.en: If you've got a nice jacket, wear that with a skirt or trousers.
sentences.zh: 如果你有一件漂亮的夹克，可以搭配裙子或西裤穿着。

sentences.en: MARTHA: OK.
sentences.zh: MARTHA: 好的。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Any other tips?
sentences.zh: 还有其他建议吗？

sentences.en: ALEX: Erm, well I know it's really obvious but arrive in plenty of time.
sentences.zh: ALEX: 嗯……我知道这听起来很老生常谈，但一定要提前足够的时间到达。

sentences.en: They hate people who are late.
sentences.zh: 他们特别反感迟到的人。

sentences.en: So make sure you know exactly where you have to get to.
sentences.zh: 所以务必清楚自己要去的具体地点。

sentences.en: And one other useful piece of advice my manager told me before I had the interview for this job - is to smile.
sentences.zh: 另外，我面试这份工作前，我的主管还给了我一条实用建议——那就是微笑。

sentences.en: Even if you feel terrified.
sentences.zh: 即使你内心感到极度紧张。

sentences.en: It makes people respond better to you.
sentences.zh: 这会让你更容易获得他人积极的回应。

sentences.en: MARTHA: I'll have to practise doing that in the mirror!
sentences.zh: MARTHA: 我得对着镜子练习一下！

sentences.en: ALEX: Yeah - well, good luck.
sentences.zh: ALEX: 是啊——祝你好运！

sentences.en: Let me know if you need any more information.
sentences.zh: 如果需要更多信息，请告诉我。

sentences.en: MARTHA: Thanks very much.
sentences.zh: MARTHA: 非常感谢。
